theorems.name: Submission.w12_ball_rellich_compactness
theorems.statement: ∀ n : ℕ, 1 ≤ n → ∀ (A : ℝ) (f : ℕ → Rn n → ℝ) (g : ℕ → Rn n → Rn n), (∀ k, IsW12WithGradient (f k) (g k) (ball 0 1)) → (∀ k, ∫⁻ x in ball (0 : Rn n) 1, ‖f k x‖ₑ ^ 2 ≤ ENNReal.ofReal A) → (∀ k, ∫⁻ x in ball (0 : Rn n) 1, ‖g k x‖ₑ ^ 2 ≤ ENNReal.ofReal A) → ∃ (φ : ℕ → ℕ) (w : Rn n → ℝ), StrictMono φ ∧ MemLp w 2 (volume.restrict (ball (0 : Rn n) 1)) ∧ Tendsto (fun k => ∫⁻ x in ball (0 : Rn n) 1, ‖f (φ k) x - w x‖ₑ ^ 2) atTop (𝓝 0)
theorems.natural_summary: Implements the independently reviewed natural-language proof; see the theorem issue and retained proof.
